compute.cost_note: local, offline, stdlib only (DOCX read as zipped XML); no network

do_not_use_when: the source is EPUB (use acquire_epub) or PDF (use pdf_inventory then pdf_extract)
the files mix several authors under one --persona; each run writes one persona

examples.cmd: python3 plugins/setec-voiceprint/scripts/acquire_manuscript.py my_novel.md --persona my_pen_name_fiction --register literary_horror --consent-status author_consent --ai-status pre_ai_human --segment chapter --min-words 300
examples.description: Build a personal identity baseline from a novel manuscript

inputs.target: a .docx/.md/.txt file, or a directory of them

purpose: ingest local .docx / .md / .markdown / .txt manuscripts as identity-baseline entries (the writer's own voice, the corpus a draft is compared against) or, with --corpus-role impostor, as impostor entries; segments by chapter heading, fixed word window, or whole work.
use_when: building your own identity baseline from manuscripts on disk before running voice_profile, voice_distance or general_imposters
adding a local manuscript collection to the impostor pool (--corpus-role impostor with --impostor-for)
